question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (3) i.e. **'****Abdact'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The INCORRECTLY spelt word is **Abdact**
 
• The **CORRECTLY **spelt word is **Abduct** (अपहरण करना) - To take someone away illegally, especially using force or deception.
 
 
• Example: The child was abducted from the park during the afternoon.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Abdact'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adjourn **(स्थगित करना) - To delay or postpone to a later time.
 
• **Addict **(व्यसनी) - Someone who is unable to stop using or doing something, especially something harmful.
 
• **Advise **(सलाह देना) - To offer suggestions about the best course of action to someone.
